page-layout: full
---

Meena Maharjan is a public health researcher and data analyst with over seven years of international 
experience at the intersection of global health communication, biostatistics, and AI-driven analytics. 
She specializes in evaluating public health campaigns, monitoring commercial determinants of health, 
and building data tools that translate complex evidence into actionable policy insights. Her work 
spans overdose prevention, tobacco and alcohol marketing surveillance, nutrition policy, and behavioral 
research across the United States, South Asia, Latin America, and Africa.

She holds a Master of Science in Applied Data Analytics from the University of Central Arkansas and a Master of 
Public Health in Biostatistics from SRM Institute of Science and Technology, and is currently pursuing a Doctor of Business Administration at Westcliff University.
